title: In re Lakeshore Fen Bakery Co.
forum: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, District of Minnesota; voluntary Chapter 7 asset case

timeline.event: Three star-shaped ovens delivered with signed receiving slips
Voluntary Chapter 7 petition filed; order for relief entered
Court notice identified an asset case and ordinary proof-of-claim deadline
Client found an uncredited partial payment in its ledger
Client workplan signed; draft delivery agreed for ten days after reset

documents.title: Asset-case notice
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Voluntary Chapter 7 order for relief entered sixty-seven days before reset. This is an asset case; ordinary unsecured trade claims are subject to the ordinary Rule 3002(c) period. No government claim, special exception, later asset-discovery notice, or different bar date applies.

documents.title: Oven invoice and payment ledger
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Invoice lists three star-shaped ovens for $18,600. A partial payment of $2,100 appears on the ledger. Reconcile that payment before preparing the claim.

documents.title: Agreed workplan
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Workplan § 3: Counsel will deliver a reconciled proof-of-claim draft and attachment list. Delivery is due ten calendar days after the demo reset date. This is an agreed draft-delivery milestone, separate from any filing deadline.

deadlines.label: File ordinary trade-creditor proof of claim
Agreed delivery of reconciled claim draft

clientFacing.status: The bakery entered Chapter 7. We are checking the unpaid balance before submitting your claim.
nextSteps: Confirm whether the partial payment covered these ovens.
Send the signed delivery slips so we can attach support to the claim.
